title: Semantic presentation continuity

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.

allowedWork: Presentation-group contracts, pure continuity laws, focused distribution and radical adapters, tests, stable visual tooling, proposal and Theseus evidence.
disallowedWork: New curriculum, semantic algebra changes, KaTeX changes, Three.js, renderer replacement, unrelated roadmap/thread/design changes, or broad visual redesign before exemplar promotion.
goal: Replace timing-only completion with renderer-neutral presentation-group settlement, repair distribution first, then repair power-to-radical, and promote only after human checkpoints.
commitCadence: Commit after every verified slice; stop for human acceptance after slices 20 and 27.
stopConditions: H1 PRESERVATION: stop on unexplained semantic, identity, correspondence, lineage, seek, rewind, native endpoint, typography, accessibility, route, or review drift.
H2 OWNERSHIP: stop if a renderer-neutral presentation group must own DOM, KaTeX, SVG, canvas, or WebGL resource state.
H3 EVIDENCE: stop if actual rendered output cannot be measured deterministically or opacity can conceal geometry mismatch.
H4 USER OVERLAP: stop before touching overlapping user-owned changes.
H5 SCOPE: stop if the fix requires disallowed work or architectural replacement.
H6 DISTRIBUTION CHECKPOINT: stop after slice 20 for human review before radical work.
H7 RADICAL CHECKPOINT: stop after slice 27 for human review before promotion.

slices.summary: Frozen baselines: 33 focused unit tests, 12 distribution browser tests, and 17 radical captures pass; distribution lesson and native KaTeX endpoints remain canonical.

slices.summary: Added pure reducers for measured DOM ink, alpha-grid canvas/WebGL ink, and composite owner unions; transparent padding is excluded. Six tests and full typecheck pass.

slices.summary: The intra-owner law now reports member position, size, and adjacent-gap residuals against native geometry; the reported late product gap fails while exact native geometry passes. Seven tests pass.

slices.title: Add the inter-owner presentation-equivalence law.
slices.summary: Inter-owner equivalence now checks member-local geometry plus actual ink bounds and coverage independent of opacity; a hidden mismatched owner fails. Eight focused tests pass.

slices.summary: Temporal conformance now checks exact endpoints, final relative velocity, direct-seek geometry, and reverse-equivalent samples; nine tests and full typecheck pass.

slices.title: Require every compound settlement to declare a group contract or typed exemption before promotion.
slices.summary: Promotion declaration gate requires exactly one group contract or typed exemption for every compound target; valid contracts and justified singleton exemptions pass. Ten tests pass.

slices.title: Encode both reported bugs as negative conformance fixtures.
slices.summary: Named negative fixtures reproduce the distribution factor/addend gap and the WebGL/native fraction scale-position-ink mismatch for the intended conformance reasons; 12 focused tests pass.

slices.title: Add stable visual:presentation-continuity tooling for recurring browser captures and measurements.
slices.summary: Added stable visual:presentation-continuity tooling with a versioned seven-frame plan, wide/narrow distribution coverage, radical source baseline, deterministic recapture hashes, and a manifest; test, typecheck, and capture pass.

slices.title: Measure the live distribution factor-to-term gap and final ownership seam.
slices.summary: Live Workbench edge-gap measurements reproduce the defect: absolute pre-handoff residual is 2.62px wide and 1.78px narrow versus a 0.5px budget, and persists in the temporary endpoint pose. Stable visual command and typecheck pass.

slices.title: Compile each distributed factor/addend pair as a target-product presentation group.
slices.summary: Distribution plans now compile one factor/addend presentation group per explicit semantic index; shuffled pair order maps correctly and invalid indices are rejected. Nine focused tests and full typecheck pass.

slices.title: Introduce a cohesion lock and shared product-settlement clock while retaining independent fan-out motion.
slices.summary: Distribution preserves independent fan-out before progress 0.72, then factor and addend residuals share one reversible settlement clock and both reach path completion at 0.94. Ten focused tests and stable visuals pass; remaining 2.58px box residual is correctly reserved for group-local rendering in slice 16.

slices.title: Render post-lock distribution motion in group-local target geometry.
slices.summary: After cohesion lock, native target factor/addend tokens move under one group offset while source material crossfades away; target spacing stays exact during settlement. Seventeen unit checks, typecheck, focused browser regression, and stable visuals pass.

slices.title: Gate distribution native transfer on true group residual and velocity.
slices.summary: Full native ownership is now gated by group-offset residual and sampled relative velocity. Browser proof shows source/target opacity conservation during settlement and exact target ownership by 0.94; active pre-handoff and endpoint residuals are 0px wide and narrow. Eighteen unit checks, typecheck, browser, and stable visuals pass.

slices.title: Cover arbitrary product positions, multi-term distribution, nested terms, fonts, and responsive widths.
slices.summary: Semantic-index grouping and settlement cover three products, shuffled positions, wide and nested addends; responsive wide/narrow captures prove zero active residual at pre-handoff and endpoint. Nine focused tests and stable visuals pass (visual rerun required normal loopback-server authority).

slices.title: Prove lesson/card canonical schedule parity and produce the distribution contact sheet.
slices.summary: Lesson/card parity is executable at seven canonical samples (within 1e-12 numeric normalization). Stable tooling produces 13 deterministic paired lesson/card and radical captures plus a distribution contact sheet; 12/12 lesson browser tests, typecheck, and visual gates pass.

slices.title: Distribution human checkpoint.
slices.summary: User visually accepted the distribution checkpoint. Persistent terms and operations converge as fully opaque moving owners and swap discretely at matching native ink geometry in forward and rewind playback; generic regression gates remain green.

slices.title: Measure actual WebGL source ink against live native 1/2, replacing metadata-only diagnosis.
slices.summary: Added on-demand WebGL alpha readback and independent live KaTeX source-fraction raster bounds. Stable evidence at semantic progress 0.04 shows recorded readiness residual 0px but actual rendered/native maximum residual 1px (7x20px versus 6x20px), deterministically replacing the metadata-only diagnosis without changing motion.

slices.title: Remove the self-comparison geometry check and feed actual outgoing/incoming observations into settlement.
slices.summary: Removed metadata self-comparisons for both radical endpoints. Source and target settlement now consume on-demand rendered WebGL ink and independent live native ink; each measured 1px mismatch is recorded and blocks transfer. Dual-endpoint manifest, focused browser/unit tests, canonical captures, and typecheck pass.

slices.title: Make the WebGL source endpoint render the exact captured fraction without residual SDF deformation.
slices.summary: WebGL source endpoint now preserves exact captured fraction ink: removing unnecessary single-quad blending prevents alpha squaring, and atlas regions retain device-pixel dimensions without fractional recapture scaling. Stable source evidence is 6x20px versus 6x20px with zero size residual; remaining subpixel translation stays measured and blocked for slice 24.

slices.title: Reconcile remaining translation and scale before discrete handoff; block transfer until genuinely ready.
slices.summary: Calibrated WebGL source and target ink against independently captured native KaTeX bounds, including endpoint scale and translation. Settlement now retains exactly one fully opaque owner and switches discretely only after measured geometry is exact. Stable source/target evidence records zero residual, overlap, and vacancy; focused unit/browser, canonical visual, and typecheck gates pass.

slices.title: Prove forward, rewind, direct seek, fallback, reduced motion, resize, and font invalidation.
slices.summary: Proved exact radical handoffs across forward and rewind direct seeks, reduced-motion and efficient DOM fallbacks, responsive resize, and font invalidation. Font/resize measurement invalidation now discards the captured radical atlas so paused frames rebuild at the same semantic instant, and continuity diagnostics read the explicit discrete handoff phase rather than opacity progress. Six radical browser tests, focused unit tests, stable visuals, typecheck, and the shared linear-renderer impact gate pass.

slices.title: Add dense rewind captures at semantic progress 0.06, 0.03, 0.01, and 0, including owner overlays.
slices.summary: Added stable rewind captures at semantic progress 0.06, 0.03, 0.01, and 0 with measured moving/native ink outlines and explicit owner badges. The new evidence caught and fixed a direction-dependent capture defect: atlas initialization had rasterized the already-collapsed rewind seed. Generic native-pose capture now resets presentation transforms in the measurement and cloned raster only, preserving the full 6x20px fraction in both directions. All four frames record exact geometry, zero overlap/vacancy, and a discrete owner change; 2,162 tests, build, radical browser, canonical visuals, and shared-renderer impact gates pass.

slices.title: Radical human checkpoint.
slices.summary: Human review prefers and retains the richer WebGL-assisted radical over the KaTeX-only fallback while identifying a small initial 1/2 jerk as a known visual residual. Diagnosis and commit trail are durable; the WebGL branch remains scoped to this animation and is not evidence for family-wide root promotion.

The radical residual is linked and no motion changed.
